approved_payload.content: Police say a man of 35 was found with multiple gunshot wounds inside a vehicle at the corner of Bokmakierie Street and 7th Avenue after a shooting at about 13:25 on Monday 19 October (Constable Ndakhe Gwala, via Daily Voice). He was declared dead at the scene. Athlone police registered a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. SABC News (citing police) and Megazone say Monday night; the police statement quoted by Daily Voice gives about 13:25, and Heart FM says the afternoon. Four reports, all resting on one police account: SABC News, Heart FM, Daily Voice and Crime Scene Report (news-stuff.co.za).
